【Suitable Dimension】Each fall cutlery pouch measures about 19 x 10 cm/ 7.5 x 3.9 inches, the size can fit normal utensil cutlery,make your tableware neater.You will receive 16 paper card slots and 16 pattern cards with Thanksgiving elements in different shapes,very easy to use.
